feature: Customer Portal v2 -- MY ARCHITECT / the retainer page (/portal-v2/retainer), recreated from 'Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' markup 1981-2196 and logic class 15852-15984. A NEW page: the retainer carried 19% of its design copy (all of it built in the logic class, invisible to the page) and had no route before this. Eight retained hours a month shown as a working log at two zoom levels -- the month rollup (hours used, findings closed, what is next) and a week you select in place, which swaps the report card without moving the month.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute.
UI ROUTE SHAPE: /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/retainer. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/retainer' ABOVE the '/portal-v2/:pillar' insertion marker so the param route does not swallow it.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- these brand-new routes assert green only after the pushed commit is deployed.

THE HOUR FIGURES ARE DERIVED, NOT STORED (retainerModel.ts). RET_HOURS is { retained: 8, rolled: 2, used: 5.5 }; available = 10.0, remaining = 4.5, used% = 55 -- retainerModel.test.ts pins these at the unit level, but they are the DESIGN FIXTURE numbers, not what an unenrolled TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL account sees on screen (see #1398 note below); a future enrolled-account manifest pass should assert the real bucket arithmetic off the DOM the way this note used to describe.

THE WEEK SELECTOR IS REAL LOCAL STATE. RET6 clicks the W33 tab and RET7 asserts the report card swapped to that week's summary -- proof the selection re-renders in place rather than navigating. The month rollup above it does not move.

AN EMPTY WEEK OMITS ITS BLOCKS. W31 logged no hours, so its report has no Work log / Produced / asks blocks (buildWeekView's has* flags). Not asserted here beyond the switch, because a negative 'absent' assertion is awkward in this harness; retainerModel.test.ts covers it.
THERE IS NO NEGATIVE TEXT ASSERTION IN THIS HARNESS, and an array in `textContains` is ANY-of, not all-of. Every all-of assertion here is its own step.
NO `select` STEPS. UiTestExecutor.cs cannot drive a native <select>; this page has none in the asserted flow.

UI ONLY: the ask box, the Open-as-PDF / Open / Book time / Billing buttons are visual, to be wired in a later pass. The weekly report content (summary, per-line work log, deliverables, asks), RET_OUTCOMES, RET_TERMS, RET_DOCS and RET_COPY have no backend source and stay design fixture.

LIVE WIRING (#1285/#1293/#1398): the month bucket (retained/rolled/used) and the 'Where the hours went' work log read GET /api/portal/retainer (useRetainerLive.ts) -- real once the customer has an active retainer row (AdminV2 Retainer Hours, admin-retainer.ts). Git #1398 replaced the old two-state 'live'|'fixture' model with five real states: loading / live / empty (configured, nothing logged yet) / unconfigured (no retainer row) / error (failed read) -- only 'live' and 'empty' show real bucket numbers; 'unconfigured' and 'error' render an honest NoScanDataState instead of the design fixture. RET1/RET4 assert the honest `NoScanDataState` is what's actually on screen (not the design fixture's numbers) and RET14 reads the hidden pv2-ret-source marker to confirm the real dataState is 'unconfigured', because the harness's TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL account is not enrolled on a retainer. A future manifest pass against an enrolled test account should assert 'live'/'empty' and the real bucket/work-log numbers instead.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

LOADING-STATE FIXTURE FLASH FIX (Git #1365) -- the month rollup cards and the 'Where the hours went' work log render PortalV2LoadingState while GET /api/portal/retainer is in flight, instead of the design fixture, matching the pattern #1343 established for Ownership/Change Control. Not asserted with a new uiStep here: the loading window is typically sub-200ms against the dev/test API, so gating a step on it would be a flaky race rather than reliable coverage. RET1/RET4/RET14's settled honest-empty assertions above are the SETTLED (post-loading) state.

REMAINING FIXTURE LEAKS FIXED (Git #1401) -- the page title's month/year, the header architect/billing line, and the rolled-hours expiry/countdown text (RET_COPY.heading/architect/billing/rolledExpiry/remainingTail) were unconditional design-fixture strings even after #1398 (which only fixed the bucket's hour NUMBERS) -- a fictional architect name and dollar figure sat next to genuinely real hour counts. All five are now real (retainerModel.ts's currentHeadingLabel/rolledExpiryLabel/daysLeftInPeriodLabel + useRetainerLive.ts now also carrying settings.architectName/hourlyRateCents and bucket.period off the same GET /api/portal/retainer payload). RET-title's assertion is unchanged and still passes because it happens to be checking the REAL current calendar month (August 2026 at the time of this fix) rather than a hardcoded one now. RET15 asserts the architect/billing block renders (empty, honestly) for the unenrolled TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL account -- this harness has no negative-text assertion capability (see the note above), so a fictional-name/dollar-figure regression there is NOT mechanically caught here; verified by direct code review instead. A future manifest pass against an enrolled test account with a real architect_name/hourly_rate_cents set should assert the real architect/billing/rolledExpiry/remainingTail text instead.
